API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APICertificate ManagementGets all issued certificates for the specified customer. This API will be deprecated in a future release.
Gets all issued certificates for the specified customer. This API will be deprecated in a future release.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/:customerId/clientlessCertificate/issued
DEPRECATED

This endpoint has been deprecated and may be replaced or removed in future versions of the API.

Gets all issued certificates for the specified customer. This API will be deprecated in a future release.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to support search by features and fields for the API.

page
int32

Specifies the page number.

Example: 1
pagesize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 20. The max page size is 500.

Example: 20
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

400
401
403
404

415

OK
